subject: Discovery recap + counsel hold — OliveBank pilot
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: James Porter <jporter@olivebank.com>, Maya Singh <m.singh@olivebank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap & next steps from today's discovery — OliveBank pilot

Hi James / Maya,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and very helpful to understand the compliance bar and performance targets for the pilot. Short recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned: 

- Objective: 6-week pilot to validate Redwood inference latency and integration with OliveBank's chat assistant (payments + account lookups).
- Success metrics: median token latency < 180ms p95 < 350ms; 99% inference availability; key prompt-level precision checks on PII masking.
- Data flow: request tokens only (no customer payload persisted); support for VPC private deployment if procurement requires it.
- Pricing: pilot pricing as quoted in the deck (one-time pilot fee + usage rate) — I'll attach the SOW and a simple mutual action plan.

Next steps I volunteered:
1) Send a short SOW + mutual action plan for legal/procurement to review (today).
2) Connect engineering contacts (your infra lead + our integration engineer) to walk through the API and VPC options (week of 27 Sep).
3) Procurement/counsel review contract and return redlines (target within 7–10 business days).

Monica — looping you in for the SOW and redline expectations; happy to summarize the specific change requests OliveBank may have based on today's call.

James — I'll drop the documents in this thread shortly. If your procurement timeline has slipped or the priority has shifted, let me know so we can adjust the cadence.

Thanks,

— Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: olivebank_sow_draft.pdf (attachment stub)

Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: SOW + mutual action plan (attached)

James / Maya —

Attached: SOW draft and a 1-page mutual action plan. Quick notes:
- Pilot start assumed 4 Oct (tentative) pending procurement sign-off.
- We kept data residency and VPC options explicit in section 3.
- If counsel asks for alternative indemnity language we can provide a limited-risk clause rather than full vendor indemnity.

Monica — included clauses we typically see pushed back on so you have context. Appreciate any quick callouts.

If I don't hear back by Friday 24 Sep we'll assume procurement will start review the week of 27 Sep.

Best,
Priyom

Attachments: olivebank_sow_draft.pdf (attachment stub), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: James Porter <jporter@olivebank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <m.singh@olivebank.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@olivebank.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 08:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW + mutual action plan (attached)

Priyom —

Thanks for the materials. We've shared with our counsel and procurement. A quick status update: counsel has a few redlines around data retention language, audit access, and indemnity scope. Procurement asked for a tracked copy and a short summary of the ask vs. your standard. I'm attaching the redlines they returned.

Can you confirm your engineering team can support the VPC option if counsel requires it for the pilot? That will be a gating item.

Also, procurement would like to see a target timeline for counter-signature; can you propose a 2–3 week review window?

Thanks,
James
Head of Digital Channels | OliveBank
jporter@olivebank.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

Attachment: olivebank_redlines_v1.docx (attachment stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW + mutual action plan — counsel redlines received

Priyom —

Saw James' redlines. High-level take:
- Data retention: acceptable with a maximum 30-day ephemeral cache and explicit non-persistence clause — we can sign.
- Audit access: we need to tighten the scope and propose a standard audit window (business hours, 48-hour notice).
- Indemnity: counsel asking for expansion; suggest we offer a capped liability and carve out certain third-party IP claims.

I'll prepare a tracked counter and a 1-page summary of the change positions. Given their request for VPC, confirm engineering can enable a customer VPC pilot within standard timelines — if yes, tell procurement that so it doesn't stall.

Also, flag: if procurement asks for SOC 2 Type II evidence, we can provide our report and an ATO letter — let me know if OliveBank needs that earlier.

-Monica
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: James Porter <jporter@olivebank.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@olivebank.com>, Maya Singh <m.singh@olivebank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — counsel timeline and next steps (blocked by counsel?)

Hi James / Procurement team —

Following up on the redlines James shared last week. Monica is preparing a tracked counter and summary (will send today), and engineering has confirmed the VPC pilot is available within our standard onboarding window.

Two quick asks so we can keep the pilot on the Oct timeline:
1) Can procurement confirm whether counsel will prioritize the counter-sign within a 10 business-day review? If not, what's the expected ETA so we can reschedule integration support.
2) Are there any additional evidence items (SOC 2, KMS attestation, network diagrams) that counsel needs now to move faster? Monica can provide the doc list.

If this is just a brief internal review, we'll hold our proposed start date; if counsel needs more time we should shift the integration kick to avoid idle onboarding capacity.

Appreciate a quick signal so we can plan.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

PS — Monica will attach the counter and a short redline summary later today.
